name: Shields
overview: Scripture portrays shields as essential elements of defense and divine protection. They were not only physical armor borne by warriors, as seen in 1 Samuel 17:7 where a shield bearer precedes the giant Goliath, but also spiritual symbols of God's safeguarding presence, exemplified in Genesis 15:1 where God declares Himself as Abram's shield and exceeding great reward. The Psalms affirm this protective role, describing the shield as a gift of salvation from God (2 Samuel 22:36), while historical accounts reveal their material value and significance, such as the golden shields taken by David from Hadadezer's servants (2 Samuel 8:7). The disgrace associated with losing a shield, noted in 2 Samuel 1:21 regarding Saul's shield being cast away, underscores the importance of faith and divine favor in maintaining God's protection.
